prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1370; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling lawfully in their lane when your insured's vehicle crossed the centerline and struck our client's vehicle head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force of the collision was sufficient to cause a fracture of our client's wrist, which required immobilization, medical evaluation, and ongoing treatment. Our client has experienced pain, reduced grip strength, and limitations in daily activities, and continues to undergo physical therapy.

The police report documents your insured's failure to maintain the proper lane, and the physical evidence is consistent with our client's account of how the collision occurred. Liability in this matter is clear. We have enclosed the medical records, imaging studies, treatment bills, and wage documentation supporting our client's claim.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice. We look forward to your prompt reply.
